scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js && npm run build:chakra
scripts.build:css: style-dictionary build --verbose --config config/css-light.js && style-dictionary build --verbose --config config/css-dark.js
scripts.build:chakra: style-dictionary build --verbose --config config/chakra-v3-tokens.js && style-dictionary build --verbose --config config/chakra-v3-semanticTokens.js && style-dictionary build --verbose --config config/chakra-v2-tokens.js
scripts.check: npm run validate:tokens && npm run build && npm run validate:css && npm run validate:chakra && npm run validate:chart-a11y
